segments.ja297:1.3: Vajjāsi kho tvaṃ vāmūruṃ, ciraṃ kho sā karissati [sarissati (ka.)].
segments.ja297:2.1: Idaṃ kho sā na jānāti, asiṃ sattiñca oḍḍitaṃ;
segments.ja297:2.3: Sā caṇḍī kāhati kodhaṃ, taṃ me tapati no idaṃ [no idha (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja297:3.1: Esa uppalasannāho, nikkhañcussīsakohitaṃ [nikkhamussīsake kataṃ (sī. pī.), nikkhañcussīsake kataṃ (syā.)];
segments.ja297:3.3: Kāsikañca muduṃ vatthaṃ, tappetu dhanikā piyāti [dhanakāmiyāti (syā. pī.), dhanakāmikāti (sī.)].
